first_handback:
I read all 90 files in order and wrote the report with 90 table rows. Each row has the file name, station name, founding year and founder.

Report: /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/e2-c3/lab/__reports__/wave-04/explorer-w04-e2c3/00-findings_v0.md
Puzzles: /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/e2-c3/lab/__scrupuli__/wave-04-explorer-w04-e2c3.md

I generated the table rows with a sed loop over the files and checked that there are 90 of them. I printed only the header and the first five rows to check them. I did not read the other rows back, so I haven't verified the rest.

Many station names appear in more than one file with a different founder or year. Slatemoor in f003 and f005 has the same year but different founders. Heathgate in f014, f021 and f089 has three different years and founders. I kept each file as its own row and did not decide which entry is right.

Not covered: elevation, population, occupation and wind-interval fields, since you asked only for name, year and founder.

The cost, as shown in my context, was about $0.31, slightly over the $0.30 brief.
